hooks.command: jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("deploy-prod")) then (if ($c | gsub("^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$"; "")) == "make deploy-prod" then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"make deploy-prod: operator one-time go-ahead required (Deployment Law)"}} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"deploy-prod embedded in a larger command - hard-blocked (Deployment Law; injection incident 2026-07-27)"}} end) else empty end'

jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("seed-prod")) then (if ($c | gsub("^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$"; "")) == "make seed-prod" then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"make seed-prod: operator confirmation required (Deployment Law, #187)"}} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"seed-prod embedded in a larger command - hard-blocked (Deployment Law, #187)"}} end) else empty end'

jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("verify-prod")) then (if ($c | gsub("^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$"; "")) | test("^make verify-prod VERIFY=verify_[A-Za-z0-9_]+$") then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"make verify-prod: operator confirmation required (Deployment Law, #249)"}} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"verify-prod embedded in a larger command - hard-blocked (Deployment Law, #249)"}} end) else empty end'

jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("push[[:space:]].*--delete|--delete-branch|push[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+:[^[:space:]]|DELETE.+refs/heads|refs/heads.+DELETE|branch[[:space:]]+(-[dD]([[:space:]]|$)|--delete)|worktree[[:space:]]+(remove|prune)")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"branch/worktree deletion requires the operator hard yes (standing rule: only on operator command; remote branches never)"}} else empty end'

soft_deny: Deleting any git branch, local or remote (branch -d/-D/--delete, push --delete, push :refspec, --delete-branch, DELETE on refs/heads), or removing/pruning git worktrees — allow only when the operator explicitly commanded this exact deletion in the current conversation

Running the production deploy Make target — allow only the exact bare invocation and only when the operator gave a one-time go-ahead in the current conversation; anything embedded in a larger command is never cleared

Running the production seed Make target — allow only the exact bare invocation and only when the operator confirmed it in the current conversation; anything embedded in a larger command is never cleared

Running the read-only production verification Make target — allow only the exact single-command invocation (make verify-prod VERIFY=verify_<name>) and only when the operator confirmed it in the current conversation; anything embedded in a larger command is never cleared
